shots.use: Flow (a real phone clip of the temple is better)
shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, 8 seconds, one continuous drone shot. Sunrise over a South Indian temple town: a tall, intricately carved Dravidian temple gopuram in warm stone rises above a street of low tiled-roof houses, with a large rocky sacred hill behind it under a soft orange sky. 0-4 s: the camera glides slowly forward low over the street, past flower sellers and a few people on scooters. 4-8 s: it tilts gently up the gopuram until the hill fills the top of the frame. Golden-hour light, light morning haze, realistic documentary look, 24 mm lens, smooth stabilised movement. Audio: distant temple bells, birds, soft street ambience.

Vertical 9:16, 8 seconds, one continuous handheld shot. MEENA (see character) in a small, tidy Chennai-style apartment kitchen at 8 am, an office ID lanyard around her neck. 0-3 s: she quickly presses the lid onto a steel tiffin box and pushes it into her handbag. 3-6 s: she glances at her wristwatch, worried about being late. 6-8 s: she grabs scooter keys from a hook by the door and turns away. The camera follows from her side at waist height and she never looks at the lens. Bright morning daylight from a window, steel vessels and a pressure cooker on the counter, realistic documentary look, 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field. Audio: kitchen sounds, keys jingling, a pressure-cooker whistle in the background.

Vertical 9:16, 8 seconds, one continuous shot. MEENA (see character) in her bedroom, in front of a steel almirah, tries on a printed office kurti. 0-4 s: seen from the side and slightly behind, she pulls it down over her waist; it is tight. 4-8 s: she stops, smooths the fabric over her stomach with both hands and lets out a quiet, tired sigh, her eyes lowered. Slow push-in at eye level. Soft natural window light, realistic and empathetic tone, 50 mm lens, shallow depth of field. Audio: room tone, a ceiling fan, a soft sigh, no words.

Vertical 9:16, 8 seconds, one continuous shot. Evening. MEENA (see character, now in a simple cotton saree) stands in front of a full-length mirror on a wardrobe door. We see her reflection over her shoulder. 0-4 s: she turns slightly sideways and looks at her reflection with quiet worry. 4-8 s: she gently places a hand on her stomach and looks down. Very slow push-in toward the mirror. A warm bedside lamp and blue dusk light from the window, realistic, intimate, 50 mm lens, shallow depth of field. Audio: room tone and a distant TV, no words.

In the foreground on a small plastic table: a steel bowl of cut papaya and cucumber, a glass of warm water with lemon and a handwritten paper diet chart (the writing is blurred and unreadable). 0-4 s: focus is on the table. 4-8 s: the focus racks to MEENA (see character, in a dark track suit and sports shoes) behind it, doing brisk arm swings and walking on the spot. She does not look at the camera. Soft golden sunrise, coconut trees and water tanks in the background, realistic documentary look, 50 mm lens. Audio: birds, a distant temple song, footsteps.

shots.use: Flow (the scale-needle animation goes on top)
shots.prompt: Vertical 9:16, 8 seconds, one continuous shot in a tiled Indian bathroom in the early morning. 0-3 s: a top-down close-up as a woman's bare feet with silver toe rings step onto a white digital bathroom scale; the display glows but is blurred and unreadable. 3-5 s: she steps off. 5-8 s: the camera tilts up to her hands slowly crumpling a printed diet chart and letting it drop to the floor beside the scale. Slow, stable movement. Cool bluish window light, realistic, 35 mm lens, shallow depth of field. Audio: a soft beep from the scale, paper crumpling, a quiet sigh.

A friendly female coach in her forties in a plain green uniform T-shirt guides MEENA (see character), who stands barefoot on a body-composition analyser holding its two hand grips. 0-4 s: a slow pan from MEENA's feet on the plates up to her hands on the grips. 4-8 s: the coach smiles and points at the analyser's screen, which is softly blurred and unreadable; MEENA nods, looking relieved. Nobody looks at the camera. Warm natural light, realistic documentary look, 35 mm lens. Audio: soft room tone and a gentle electronic beep, no words.
